simple.meaning: נֹבַח (Nôbach) is a Hebrew word meaning “Nobach , the name of an Israelite, and of a place East of the Jordan.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: נֹבַח (H5025) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Numbers 32:42, with occurrences in Numbers, Judges.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נֹבַח (H5025) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in נֹבַח (H5025) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: נֹבַח (Nôbach) / H5025 is traced through Numbers 32:42, Judges 8:11 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

occurrences.englishText: Nobah went and took Kenath and its villages, and called it Nobah, after his own name.
